principle: CLASS BASELINE != CONFIGURATION PROFILE != REFIT PACKAGE != INDIVIDUAL SHIP LIVE STATE
rules: A refit never modifies the immutable class baseline directly.
Applied refits are recorded on the individual ship and its current configuration.
A refit cannot introduce technology beyond the era matrix unless explicit experimental or special provenance allows it.
A refit may change interior topology; those changes require a configuration/topology override rather than silently editing the class layout.
A refit package may be historically associated with a class without being applied to every surviving hull.
Individual-only modifications must not be generalized to the class.
